title: Exercise Example with Bold Labels

illustrates.quote: Format exercise examples in the same manner as the following questions/answers.

blocks.text: Write a pronoun that can be substituted for the italicized word or group of words.

items.text: **Example** *France* was an important center for painters
1. *Women* were not accepted as artists until quite recently.
2. People ignored *Mary Cassatt* for years, and her work is famous.

print.notes: Labels "Example"/"Answer" are printed bold with no following punctuation (10.8.1: retain emphasis on a label not followed by punctuation); "France"/"Women" are italicized, "Mary Cassatt" is printed in a different emphasis — built with Emboss’s own cell-markup DSL as the nearest available approximation.
